source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique OOB SEL clock read; setter and UTC-offset operations are separate.

source_snapshot.procedure: Raw 0x0A/0x48, decode four LS-byte-first epoch bytes, render with local date; surrounding log clear.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES high-level sel time get with password argv.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correct read direction but unsafe credentials and no epoch/offset/tolerance oracle.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE with little-endian parsing, raw/decimal/offset context and explicit drift policy.
historical_reviews.history: Set SEL Time and UTC Offset remain independently governed.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Readback may be automated; Review does not assert clock accuracy without Project reference.

original_test_intent: Read the SEL device clock, decode its four-byte value and compare it with an approved time reference and offset policy.
original_method: Issue Storage 0x0A/0x48 and convert the little-endian seconds value to a timestamp.
manual_activity: Owner supplies authoritative clock/timezone model and permitted drift tolerance once.
safety_requirements: Validate response length and invalid values
agent_execution_scope: Capture reference time around one query

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: High-level get is a useful cross-check but argv credentials and unqualified local-time rendering are insufficient.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected raw 0x0A/0x48, retain four bytes and decimal value, then compare using the approved SEL offset/time model.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Raw command, example conversion, Script and timing preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bracket the read with a reference clock and report raw epoch, interpreted time basis, offset and drift separately.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes the implicit CST/local-time assumption and adds an objective tolerance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Successful decoding alone does not establish clock accuracy or future event timestamps.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong endian or timezone assumptions can create hours-scale apparent drift.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish/vendor time property is equivalent only if its epoch, offset, freshness and latency semantics match the SEL device clock.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title and raw query align; the local/CST rendering is underspecified but Review can preserve and qualify it.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read semantics are clear; time basis and tolerance are Project readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Makes endian, time basis, offset, latency and drift explicit while preserving the SEL evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The returned integer is only unambiguous as raw seconds; human time depends on SEL initialization and UTC-offset policy. A reliable comparison brackets network latency with a reference clock and records both raw value and chosen interpretation rather than treating the client locale as authoritative.

source_provenance.history: Exact-code and paired time/offset operations search
